# Initial Non-Functional Requirements

## Accessibility and Language

- Meet the organization's current accessibility standard.
- Provide the user interface in two approved user-facing languages at launch.
- Do not silently display content in an unrelated language when a translation
  is unavailable.

## Security and Privacy

- Use the organizational identity service.
- Apply role-based access for staff, managers, coordinators, administrators,
  and support.
- Record material administrative and approval actions.
- Minimize stored personal information.

## Service Quality

- Support modern organization-managed browsers.
- Target 99.5 percent monthly availability outside announced maintenance.
- Return common search results within two seconds for 95 percent of requests
  under the agreed launch load.
- Restore service within four hours after a confirmed major failure.

Expected usage volume, peak concurrency, retention, maintenance windows, and
formal recovery-point objectives remain undecided.
